name: Inspire
description: Inspire is the ability to motivate and uplift others, sparking creativity and a sense of purpose. Leaders who possess this quality encourage those around them to reach their full potential and strive for excellence.

name: Develop
description: Develop is the process of nurturing and enhancing skills, knowledge, and capabilities. This involves mentorship, training programs, and creating an environment that fosters continuous learning and personal growth.

name: Influence
description: Influence is the power to affect decisions, opinions, and behaviors. Effective influencers can sway others toward a particular idea, course of action, or mindset. It involves persuasion, charisma, and the ability to build strong connections.
